long.title: MS Dhoni IPL Captaincy: The Complete Record, 2008-2025 | Data Story Ep 14
long.description:
MS Dhoni's IPL captaincy, the complete record: every season from 2008 to 2025, not just the recent ones. 235 matches as captain (Chennai Super Kings and Rising Pune Supergiant), 136 wins, five titles (level with Rohit Sharma as the most by a captain). CSK reached ten finals in the sixteen seasons they played, and the playoffs in twelve of them. Against Mumbai Indians, the next best franchise: playoffs 12 of 16 seasons vs 11 of 18, finals 10 vs 6, titles 5 each. Over all eighteen seasons CSK won 57% of their decided matches, more than any franchise; Mumbai 55%, everyone else 52% or below.

We state wins, finals and playoff seasons per season, not losses, because Cricsheet lacks a few abandoned matches. Win rate = wins / (wins + losses). Dhoni's own record is won 136 of 235 (57.87% counts no-results as matches).
